_note: Copy to WORK/episode.json and fill. A real episode has 16-28 shots of 3-10 s, 120-180 s in all. Characters only by cast.json key; wardrobe by its key there. Times in each shot are planned by episode.py at 145 wpm; never write them by hand.
title_vi: Chiếc xe không chịu nổ máy
premise: On her first morning at a new job, Nora's car dies and the neighbour she has been avoiding offers a ride.
location: Larkmont, a small city in central Pennsylvania
situation: car won't start on the first day of work

title_card.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州 · 拉克蒙特

beats.opening: A key turns, the engine coughs and dies; Nora in her work blazer stares at the dashboard clock: 8:12.
beats.goal: Be at Keystone Mutual by 8:30 on her first day.
beats.obstacle: The Corolla is dead and the only help is Danny, whose radio woke her at six.
beats.turn: Danny's pickup is slower and louder, but he knows the back way and Grace's habits.
beats.ending: Nora arrives at 8:41; Grace says nothing, then leaves a coffee on her desk.

shots.place: Orchard Street, a steep street of red-brick twin houses with white porches and maple trees in full orange
shots.time: 8:10 a.m., low autumn sun from the left, light mist in the valley
shots.framing: wide establishing shot from the bottom of the street, eye level, the tan Corolla parked at the curb in the middle distance
shots.action: Nora hurries down the porch steps of number 412 with her shoulder bag and gets into the tan 1979 Corolla; a paperboy on a bicycle passes the other way.
shots.ambience: birds, a distant dog, a screen door clapping shut, leaves scraping on the pavement
shots.continuity: the Corolla faces downhill; the rust bubble on its rear left wheel arch is visible

shots.place: inside the tan 1979 Toyota Corolla at the curb on Orchard Street
shots.time: 8:11 a.m., soft sunlight through the windshield
shots.framing: medium shot through the windshield from the hood, Nora in the driver's seat, the street behind her through the rear window
shots.action: Nora turns the key twice; the engine coughs and dies; she rests her forehead on the steering wheel for one breath, then looks up.
shots.ambience: starter motor grinding, a cough of the engine, then silence and birds

lines.delivery: quietly, through her teeth, not shouting

shots.continuity: her bag on the passenger seat, keys in the ignition

new_facts: Nora's Corolla has a weak starter (Tommy suspects the solenoid).

sound_notes: Music bed: soft mid-80s instrumental (electric piano, chorus guitar, light drum machine), in under S01, ducked under every line. Hard cuts on action; the pickup's engine noise bridges S05-S06.
